messages:
infra-bot: Incident created -> private-agent control-plane connectivity failures in eu-west-2. Initial detection 1949998888. Impact: private deployments in eu-west-2 unable to establish control-plane websocket -> customers see 502/connection-timeout. Runbook: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-7621 :rotating_light:

maria (oncall): seeing a spike of `TLS handshake` errors and `403` in control-plane sidecar logs. Repro on a test agent in our lab.

kevin: confirmed — our recent infra change pushed a provider-level denylist that includes the control-plane egress range. Looks like the denylist rule cascaded to the transit VPC connectors.

jess: timeline? which change?

kevin: firewall rule PR #4827 merged at 1949998600. It applied a denylist for suspicious IPs; the cloud provider auto-expanded the list and overlapped the control-plane egress block.

maria (oncall): mitigation in progress: rolling back PR, updating allowlist to explicitly permit control-plane CIDR, and restarting transit proxies. Triggering config rollback now. ETA 10-15m.

sre_lead: please also update runbook and mark customers impacted so support can notify.

support_lead: prepping customer comms. Short message draft: "We're investigating connection failures affecting private deployments in eu-west-2. Engineers have identified a firewall rule interaction and are rolling a rollback. We'll post updates on https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-7621." Will send to affected accounts once rollback confirms.

kevin: rollback applied at 1949999000 -> firewall rules reverted. Restarting transit proxies.

maria (oncall): rolling restarts complete at 1949999105. Control-plane websockets re-established on test agent. Observability shows connections returning.

infra-bot: Post-rollback metrics: control-plane success rate in eu-west-2 improved from 42% -> 98% within 3m.

maria (oncall): running additional verification across customers. Two customers reported persistent failures — escalated for hand-off to solutions-eng for in-tenant checks.

jess: root cause summary to include: overly-broad provider denylist rule + missing explicit allowlist for control-plane CIDR in transit VPC. Action items: (1) add explicit allowlist entry, (2) add e2e test for private-agent control-plane connectivity on infra deploy, (3) add alert when control-plane success rate drops below 90% for >5m.

support_lead: sent initial customer note at 1949999220 to impacted accounts. Will follow up with final summary after RCA.

sre_lead: good job. Leave incident open until RCA doc posted and allowlist change verified in prod for 24h. Next update when RCA draft is ready.

kevin: quick checklist for handoff (pasted):
```
- Revert PR #4827 (done)
- Add allowlist entry: 10.84.128.0/20 -> control-plane egress (in progress)
- Deploy new transit-proxy containers (done)
- Run infra e2e-connectivity test (queued)
- Post RCA to /docs/incidents/INC-7621
```

infra-bot: Incident status -> mitigated (partial). Channel will receive final update when RCA posted.
